query: Qwen-Image-Edit model init intermittently takes ~180s (30% of runs) on a 4090; 'Model Initializing' stall with no error.

desired.outcome: OP (C3): self-diagnosed that model init needs fast disk reads - below ~1GB/s causes the stall. hccx666 (C4) adds a Linux 7.0.2 kernel regression report (suggest 7.0.1). Nothing conclusively fixed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Correlate an intermittent (~30% of runs) ~180s 'Model Initializing' stall with slow disk read throughput (<~1GB/s) and OS kernel regressions, not with model loading code.
